title: Cloud gate run: prove the epic reconciler on a deployed factory
description:
A deliberately small epic whose purpose is to be RUN, not to be valuable: it exercises EpicReconcilerWorkflow on the deployed factory with max_parallel > 1 and survives a Workflow restart with an attempt in flight.

Its two implementation ticks are real but tiny, touch different files, and remove litter rather than adding any.
acceptance_criteria: Both implementation ticks close behind their gates, the run survives a Workflow restart mid-attempt with the attempt adopted by identity rather than redispatched, and the intervention count comes from recorded data
